name: fly_list_apps
description: List all Fly.io apps in the account with status, hostname, and current release version.

name: fly_get_app
description: Get details for a specific Fly.io app by name.

name: fly_create_app
description: Create a new Fly.io app in an organization.

name: fly_delete_app
description: Delete a Fly.io app and all its machines.

name: fly_restart_app
description: Restart all machines in a Fly.io app with a rolling restart.

name: fly_move_app
description: Move a Fly.io app to a different organization.

name: fly_get_app_config
description: Get the current machine configuration for a Fly.io app including regions, image, and machine count.

name: fly_get_app_status
description: Get aggregated status for all machines in a Fly.io app — machine counts by state, regions, and overall health.

name: fly_scale_machines_count
description: Scale a Fly.io app's machine count up or down to a target number by creating or destroying machines.

name: fly_list_ips
description: List all IP addresses allocated to a Fly.io app (IPv4, IPv6, shared).

name: fly_allocate_ip
description: Allocate a new IP address (shared_v4, v4, v6) for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_release_ip
description: Release (deallocate) an IP address from a Fly.io app.

name: fly_list_machines
description: List all machines in a Fly.io app with optional state and region filters.

state.description: Filter by state: started, stopped, destroyed

name: fly_get_machine
description: Get details for a specific Fly.io machine including config, state, and region.

name: fly_create_machine
description: Create and start a new Fly.io machine with specified image, region, resources, and config.

size.description: CPU size e.g. shared-cpu-1x, shared-cpu-2x, performance-1x

name: fly_update_machine
description: Update the configuration of a running Fly.io machine (image, env, resources).

name: fly_start_machine
description: Start a stopped Fly.io machine.

name: fly_stop_machine
description: Stop a running Fly.io machine with an optional signal and grace period.

name: fly_restart_machine
description: Restart a specific Fly.io machine.

name: fly_destroy_machine
description: Permanently destroy a Fly.io machine. Set force=true to destroy even if running.

name: fly_exec_machine
description: Execute a command on a running Fly.io machine and return the output.

name: fly_list_machine_events
description: List recent lifecycle events for a Fly.io machine (starts, stops, exits, errors).

name: fly_list_machine_versions
description: List all deployed versions of a Fly.io machine with their configs.

name: fly_wait_for_machine_state
description: Poll until a Fly.io machine reaches a desired state (started, stopped, destroyed).

name: fly_get_machine_logs
description: Get recent events/log entries from a Fly.io machine.

name: fly_cordon_machine
description: Remove a Fly.io machine from load balancer rotation without stopping it (draining traffic).

name: fly_uncordon_machine
description: Add a Fly.io machine back to load balancer rotation after it was cordoned.

name: fly_clone_machine
description: Clone a Fly.io machine to the same or a different region with the same config.

name: fly_signal_machine
description: Send a Unix signal to a running Fly.io machine process (e.g. SIGUSR1 for config reload).

signal.description: Signal name e.g. SIGUSR1, SIGHUP (default SIGUSR1)

name: fly_get_machine_metadata
description: Get the metadata key-value store for a Fly.io machine.

name: fly_set_machine_metadata
description: Set a metadata key on a Fly.io machine.

name: fly_delete_machine_metadata
description: Delete a metadata key from a Fly.io machine.

name: fly_list_secrets
description: List all secrets set on a Fly.io app (key names only — values are never returned by the API).

name: fly_set_secrets
description: Set one or more secrets on a Fly.io app. Machines are restarted to pick up the new values.

secrets.description: Key-value object of secret names to values

name: fly_unset_secrets
description: Remove one or more secrets from a Fly.io app by key name.

name: fly_list_releases
description: List the 20 most recent deployment releases for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_get_release
description: Get details for a specific release version of a Fly.io app.

name: fly_rollback_release
description: Roll back a Fly.io app to a specific release version.

name: fly_list_certificates
description: List all TLS certificates (custom domains) for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_get_certificate
description: Get details for a specific TLS certificate/custom domain.

name: fly_add_certificate
description: Add a custom domain TLS certificate to a Fly.io app.

hostname.description: Custom domain to add e.g. myapp.example.com

name: fly_delete_certificate
description: Remove a custom domain TLS certificate from a Fly.io app.

name: fly_check_certificate
description: Check DNS configuration for a custom domain on a Fly.io app and show what DNS records are needed.

name: fly_list_volumes
description: List all persistent volumes for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_get_volume
description: Get details for a specific volume including size, state, and region.

name: fly_create_volume
description: Create a new persistent volume for a Fly.io app in a specific region.

name: fly_delete_volume
description: Delete a persistent volume from a Fly.io app.

name: fly_extend_volume
description: Increase the size of an existing Fly.io persistent volume.

name: fly_list_volume_snapshots
description: List all snapshots for a Fly.io volume.

name: fly_create_volume_snapshot
description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a Fly.io volume.

name: fly_fork_volume
description: Fork (clone) a Fly.io volume, optionally into a different region.

name: fly_pg_list
description: List all Fly Postgres cluster apps in the account.

name: fly_pg_create
description: Create a new Fly Postgres cluster app.

postgres_name.description: Name for the Postgres cluster app

name: fly_pg_attach_app
description: Attach an existing Fly Postgres cluster to a Fly app, creating the DATABASE_URL secret automatically.

name: fly_pg_detach_app
description: Detach a Fly Postgres cluster from an app and remove the DATABASE_URL secret.

name: fly_pg_get_connection_string
description: Get the connection string format for a Fly Postgres cluster app.

name: fly_pg_failover
description: Trigger a leader election (failover) on a Fly Postgres cluster.

name: fly_pg_list_users
description: List users in a Fly Postgres cluster.

name: fly_pg_list_databases
description: List databases in a Fly Postgres cluster.

name: fly_list_wireguard_peers
description: List WireGuard peers for a Fly.io organization's private network.

name: fly_create_wireguard_peer
description: Create a WireGuard peer for connecting to Fly.io's private network from your machine.

name: fly_delete_wireguard_peer
description: Delete a WireGuard peer from a Fly.io organization.

name: fly_list_regions
description: List all available Fly.io deployment regions with coordinates and gateway availability.

name: fly_list_vm_sizes
description: List all available Fly.io VM sizes with CPU and memory specs.

name: fly_get_platform_status
description: Get Fly.io platform status and verify API connectivity.

name: fly_list_organizations
description: List all Fly.io organizations the account belongs to.

name: fly_get_organization
description: Get details for a specific Fly.io organization including members.

name: fly_list_org_members
description: List all members of a Fly.io organization with their roles.

name: fly_add_org_member
description: Invite a user to a Fly.io organization by email.

name: fly_list_tokens
description: List deploy tokens for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_create_deploy_token
description: Create a scoped deploy token for CI/CD pipelines.

name: fly_revoke_token
description: Revoke a Fly.io deploy token by its ID.

name: fly_deploy_and_wait
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a new Fly.io machine and wait until it reaches 'started' state — deploy and verify in a single call.

name: fly_full_app_health
description: SUPER TOOL: Complete health check for a Fly.io app — machine states, IP addresses, certificates, secrets count, and recent releases in one call.

name: fly_provision_postgres_and_attach
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a Fly Postgres cluster and immediately attach it to an app, setting up DATABASE_URL automatically.

name: fly_emergency_rollback
description: SUPER TOOL: Find the last stable (complete status) release and roll back to it — one-command recovery from a bad deployment.

name: fly_set_env_variables
description: Set environment variables on a Fly.io app (deploy via GraphQL secrets endpoint). Machines restart to pick up new values.

name: fly_get_env_variables
description: Get all environment variables set on a Fly.io app from the current app configuration.

name: fly_list_app_info
description: Get comprehensive metadata for a Fly.io app including ID, organization, status, hostname, and creation timestamp.

name: fly_set_app_description
description: Update the description field for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_list_app_regions
description: List all regions where a Fly.io app is currently running machines.

name: fly_set_app_regions
description: Configure which regions a Fly.io app should run in. Creates machines in new regions.

name: fly_list_builds
description: List recent build attempts for a Fly.io app from GitHub integration or deployments.

name: fly_get_build
description: Get detailed status and logs for a specific Fly.io app build.

name: fly_deploy_from_image
description: Deploy a specific Docker image to a Fly.io app and trigger a release. Can skip health checks.

name: fly_deploy_with_volumes
description: Deploy a Docker image to a Fly.io app with persistent volumes mounted.

name: fly_list_health_checks
description: List all health check configurations defined for a Fly.io app.

name: fly_get_health_check
description: Get detailed configuration for a specific health check on a Fly.io app.

name: fly_update_health_check
description: Modify health check settings on a Fly.io app (protocol, port, path, thresholds, timeouts).

name: fly_get_app_metrics
description: Get aggregated CPU and memory metrics for all machines in a Fly.io app.

name: fly_get_machine_stats
description: Get detailed stats for a specific machine including CPU, memory, state, and health check status.

name: fly_machine_rebuild_from_image
description: Rebuild a Fly.io machine from a specified Docker image with optional health check skip.

name: fly_machine_update_restart_policy
description: Set auto-restart policy for a Fly.io machine (always, onFailure, no).

name: fly_list_machine_releases
description: List all release versions for a specific Fly.io machine.

name: fly_wait_machine_healthy
description: Poll until a Fly.io machine passes all health checks and is in a healthy state.

name: fly_get_ip_details
description: Get details for a specific IP address allocated to Fly.io including type, region, and creation date.

name: fly_list_private_networks
description: List all private networks available on Fly.io platform.

name: fly_get_app_bill
description: Get current month's billing charges for a specific Fly.io app including resource costs.

name: fly_get_organization_bill
description: Get current month's billing charges for a Fly.io organization or team.

name: fly_machine_get_process_stats
description: Get process and system statistics for a running Fly.io machine.

name: fly_machine_set_metadata
description: Set a key-value metadata pair on a Fly.io machine for custom tracking/annotations.
